rows.label: tlk45300143_05_msg0001
rows.name:
I've never felt the Invidian
Divine Beast shake like
that before, not ever.

rows.label: tlk45300143_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I can't believe we're really
going to join all the other
Divine Beasts at the World Tree...

rows.label: tlk45300143_05_msg0003
rows.name: The end of Alst, or perhaps...

rows.label: tlk45300143_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Well, come what may, you
can be sure I'll be watching
out for Hræsvelgr!

rows.label: tlk45300143_05_msg0005
rows.name:
I used to be famous as a skilled
Driver. After resting for decades,
I can fight at full strength again!

rows.label: tlk45300143_05_msg0007
rows.name: But I don't have a Blade...
